findings.evidence: PDF 68: "MLA-style latent attention does not stop the growth: it cuts the bytes/token constant (~50–60× for DeepSeek-class geometry [DERIVED])" — a bare single-axis tag. The identical computation in Ch 1 (PDF 26) carries the full pair: "32,768/576 ≈ 57×; geometry ... (DeepSeek-V2, arXiv:2405.04434) [1P][DERIVED]". Other bare single-axis instances: PDF 144 "...reused for a different generation mechanism. [DERIVED]"; PDF 153 "[1P][FACT] for the configuration; [DERIVED] for the storage."; PDF 174 "Profile the actual position count before quoting FLOPs. [DERIVED]"; PDF 175 "[1P][FACT]; measurement consequence [DERIVED]"; PDF 176 "[1P] One example: ..."; PDF 179 "...the execution-count qualification is [DERIVED]."
findings.issue: The Preface's evidence discipline (PDF 17–18) requires: "Every load-bearing quantitative claim carries Axes 1 and 2 as an inline pair ... A label pair always takes one item from each of the first two axes." The ~50–60× MLA claim is load-bearing (reused from Ch 1's taxonomy table) yet carries only the epistemic axis [DERIVED] with no provenance axis; ~8 further bare [DERIVED]/[1P] tags appear in Chs 7–8. Numbers themselves are correct and traceable; the tags are incomplete per the book's own rule. (Caveat: the Sources/Method chapter defines exceptions I could not inspect, so confidence is reduced.)
findings.fix_instruction: Expand each single-axis tag to a full pair at first inline use — e.g. PDF 68 '(~50–60× ... [1P][DERIVED])' matching Ch 1; for the '[1P][FACT] for X; [DERIVED] for Y' pattern, write the derived value as '[1P][DERIVED]' (or state once per section that the derived figures inherit the named first-party provenance).

findings.evidence: §3.3.2 (PDF 81): "We contrast with a representative MoE model in the Mixtral lineage. Its published model card gives 46.7B total and 12.9B active parameters per token [1P][FACT]." §3.3.3 (PDF 82): "the dense geometry is [canonical scenario][ASSUMPTION], the challenger's geometry is [ILLUSTRATIVE][ASSUMPTION]" — where the geometry is "32 layers, hidden 4096, GQA with 8 KV-heads × 128", i.e. the published Mixtral 8x7B configuration of the very model whose card was just tagged [1P][FACT].
findings.issue: In-model provenance split: for one model, the card totals are [1P][FACT] while the same model's published attention configuration (verifiable first-party config data, not a chosen assumption) is tagged [ILLUSTRATIVE][ASSUMPTION]. §3.3.2's header declares only two lanes ('model card [1P][FACT]; component-derived arithmetic [ILLUSTRATIVE][DERIVED]'), so the geometry tag fits neither declared lane. A reader cannot tell whether the geometry is asserted from the config or invented to match.
findings.fix_instruction: Tag the challenger's layer/head geometry [1P][FACT] (it is config data from the cited card's model), keeping [ILLUSTRATIVE] for the component-derived parameter sums; alternatively state explicitly that the geometry is 'chosen to match' the card's model and drop the [1P] citation from the totals.

findings.chapter: Preface (reading conventions) + Ch 3/4/7 references to Appendix A
findings.evidence: Preface (PDF 34): "Appendix A numbers its own sections with a letter suffix, so Appendix A § 9A means Appendix A, the section labelled 9A; the appendix's figures carry A.N." Body uses §9A (PDF 56, 58, 69) but also: PDF 33 "Appendix A, A.6 carries a boxed 2026-09-27 capability probe"; PDF 33 "(Appendix A, A.3)"; PDF 109 "Appendix A's §A.7 (Fig A.2, vendor-relative KV/compute ratios)"; PDF 166 "the A.10 First-hand Sources list".
findings.issue: Two coexisting, partly undocumented reference forms for Appendix A sections: the documented '9A' (number+letter) form and the undocumented 'A.6/A.7/A.10' (letter.number) form — the latter shape the Preface explicitly reserves for appendix figures ('the appendix's figures carry A.N'). Since 'A.2' in 'Fig A.2' is a figure while '§A.7' is claimed to be a section, the same notation denotes two different object types.
findings.fix_instruction: Pick one scheme and document it: either relabel the section pointers to the documented form (§6A, §7A, §10A) or amend the Preface convention to state that Appendix A sections are labelled A.N and its figures A.N-fig (or similar), then normalize all ~8 occurrences.
